description: This file defines an enumeration 'HostingEnvironment' representing different hosting environments (CLOUD, DOCKER, DEVELOPMENT, FILE_BASED) along with associated metadata and utility methods to retrieve configuration suffixes.

classes.name: HostingEnvironment
classes.description: An enumeration of known hosting environments with associated config file suffixes and a method to retrieve those suffixes.

methods.name: getConfigFileSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix used in config filenames to indicate the hosting environment.
